visualReview.notes: Inspected all 13 final portable views against six full local photographs, 29 contact views, the native tower footprint and City/CAC/SCB/CTBUH records. The model retains the chamfered limestone shaft, raised piers, recessed divided glazing, dark spandrels, Gothic base lights, pointed west entrance, bronze doors and glazed tympanum. The stepped crown has clustered piers, eight curved flying buttresses with real openings, pierced Gothic screens, blind niches, canopies, curving tracery, pinnacles, simplified gargoyles, a flat cap and flagpole. Reworked the first pass to correct the plain crown, oversized upper glazing, thin piers, rectangular shaft window heads and rounded entrance. Fine sculpture, aging and intermediate heights remain approximations.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected all 13 final shared-material views, including placement against the native historic footprint. Three shared material identities cover limestone, painted metal and concrete; local vertex colors distinguish trim, spandrels, opaque glazing and bronze. Six authored surface groups. The library fixture uses synthetic ground and exposes the buried footing intentionally; the portable scene uses separately preserved independent terrain. No facade photographs or neighboring model were substituted.

mediumFiReview.notes: Inspected all 25 current version-2 lighting, detail, silhouette and forced-level views. Verified the canonical Chicago asset and actual selected level in every frame; Oakland Tribune Tower is a separate asset. Four explicit levels contain 935/3921/15386/59462 triangles. Skyline preserves the native chamfers, glazing rhythm, crown setbacks, curved open buttresses, pinnacles and pole, while flattening facade recesses. District restores floor bands, base lights, rounded heads, stepped screen silhouette and upper railing. Street restores actual facade/portal recesses and floor bands. Close adds dense pointed screens, twin lancets, rosettes, canopies, blind niches, crockets, gargoyles and fine glazing bars. Error values are authoring estimates, not measured deviations.

geographicReview.notes: Uses only native historic tower part 35184499195870; the separate 20 m whole-complex footprint 35184522496073 is context. Approximate plan: 30 × 31.4 m; anchor [-87.62369692326, 41.89038181111], heading 0.010203705. Positive X points almost east, positive Z almost south, and the main entrance faces west toward Michigan Avenue. Inspected the local 2021 aerial and 2009/2013 street photographs; online map visual capture failed, so no online aerial inspection is claimed. CTBUH supplies nominal architectural/occupied/tip heights of 141.7/123.7/145.8 m, differing from native 141 m and Qualla 462 ft. One unchanged Terrarium tile, 2 m review grid and dry west approach [-19,0] establish datum 179.622 m. Independently verified all 4,225 values from original pixels, original SHA, native datum and PNG16 round trip. Native perimeter elevations span -0.0196 to +0.0934 m; footing extends to -4 m. All 96 runtime ground-closure controls pass. Terrain is unchanged; threshold engineering and other host datasets remain approximate. Bounded preview with footprint replacement disabled.

fidelityReview.scope: Historic chamfered Gothic tower: limestone shaft/recessed glazing, stepped crown/open flying buttresses/pierced screens/pinnacles/flat cap/flagpole.
fidelityReview.notes: The two individually inspected2003/2005public-domain photographs establish the historic chamfered limestone shaft, tight vertical piers/recessed window rhythm, steeply stepped central Gothic crown, arched crown glazing, independent outer piers/open curved flying buttresses, pierced galleries, pinnacles and flat upper cap/flagpole. Giorces covers the near-whole tower from Michigan Avenue; Lamarca provides a closer crown view between neighboring buildings. Current whole/front/shaft/crown/buttress/cap renders preserve those identifying forms at approximate medium-fi scope. Ground entry, hidden rear details, exact intermediate heights, fine foliate relief/fragment inventory, precise stone carving and post-conversion2026condition remain estimates from retained native-plan/architectural controls. Full original historic-tower scope remains; attached radio/TV/printingplant/newglasswings/courtyard/newTribuneEast/neighbors/statue/interiors, photo pixels, flag cloth and antennas remain excluded. Accepted at the agreed approximate medium-fi exterior scope. No reference pixels are embedded. Previously used attribution/private imagery is excluded from this current review.

runtimeLodReview.notes: Four explicit levels: 935/3921/15386/59462 triangles, six authored surface groups; strict LOD and medium-fi audits pass. The 840 actual-runtime controls cover 32 open buttress spans, 32 bridge caps, 192 near recess rays, 192 glazing closures, 192 raised floor bands, 64 lower-light recesses, 96 original-ground perimeter closures, 24 railing counters, four main-portal controls and 12 roof/terrace caps. Four authored Float32 meshes and four imported runtime meshes pass geometry, normal, winding and color checks. Counted 108 upward source roof triangles. Coarse ornament and facade depth are simplified within estimated error bounds.
